methods.label: Use the perpendicular sides
methods.explanation:
Since \(ABCD\) is a square, \(AB=10\) and \(AB\perp BC\). Because \(E\) lies on \(\overline{BC}\), triangle \(ABE\) has base \(BE\) and perpendicular height \(AB=10\). The triangle area formula gives
\[
40=\frac12\cdot BE\cdot10,
\qquad
BE=\frac{2\cdot40}{10}=8.
\]
This length lies between \(0\) and \(BC=10\), as required. Thus \(BE=\boxed{8}\), choice \(\mathrm{E}\).
